fields.content: The sauce texture was perfect after the simmer.
Added extra basil and it turned out great.
Great for meal prep and freezer portions.
Balanced spice and creaminess, loved it.
Broiled the chicken for more char and it worked well.
Made this with naan and cucumber salad.
Very filling and easy for weeknights.
Used smoked paprika and got deeper flavor.
Tastes even better the next day.
Egg timing in the final step was spot on.
Served with toasted sourdough and loved it.
A great brunch recipe for guests.
Quick breakfast and the kids liked it.
Texture stayed soft even after reheating.

fields.description: Cook spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Saute onion, carrot, celery, and garlic in olive oil until softened.
Brown beef, then stir in tomato paste and crushed tomatoes.
Simmer 30 minutes and finish with milk, basil, and parmesan.
Marinate chicken with yogurt, lemon juice, and spices for 1 hour.
Roast marinated chicken until lightly charred.
Cook onion, garlic, and ginger in butter, then add tomato puree.
Fold in cream and chicken, simmer, and serve with rice and cilantro.
Cook onion, bell pepper, and garlic in olive oil.
Add chili powder, cumin, and cocoa powder; toast for 1 minute.
Stir in tomatoes, broth, and all beans, then simmer 35 minutes.
Saute onion, pepper, and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Add tomatoes and spices, then simmer until thickened.
Crack eggs into wells and cook until whites set, then top with feta and parsley.
Blend oats, banana, egg, milk, baking powder, cinnamon, and vanilla.
Cook pancakes in a buttered skillet until golden.
Serve warm with maple syrup.
